name: Saved Wi-Fi networks and passwords
plain: Blocked: apps cannot list the networks the phone has joined before.
meaning: Past networks reveal places the person has been. Android 10 removed list access; iOS never exposed it.

android.note: Apps only see networks they suggested

ios.note: Only networks configured by the app itself

limits.headline: Can't see the Wi-Fi networks or passwords your phone has saved
limits.user_action: Nothing. Apps may try during network setup, but it fails
can: See only networks the app itself suggested
See an empty list on Android 10 and newer
See only networks the app set up itself on iPhone
cannot: Use system level Wi-Fi settings; that needs a permission only the OS has

story.what_it_is: Apps cannot list the Wi-Fi networks your phone has joined before, or see their passwords.
story.for_you: You never see it, because the door is closed. Your home, work and hotel networks stay private. A random app cannot learn where you have been from your saved networks.
story.for_makers: Makers once could read saved networks, which gave a map of the places you have been. They now ask you for one network at a time. Password sharing between phones is done by the system.

use_cases.example: Data firms wanted the list of saved networks to learn the places you visit.
Malware wanted saved passwords to join your home network and attack devices on it.
Wi-Fi backup apps wanted to copy your saved passwords to a new phone, and now use the system backup.
Setup apps wanted your home network list, and now ask you to pick one.
Airport apps wanted to join known networks, and now use a suggestion that you approve.
Companies push a work Wi-Fi profile with a management tool.

story.android_note: Android 10 removed list access for normal apps, and system sharing uses a QR code with your approval.
story.ios_note: iPhone never allowed apps to list saved networks, and shares passwords through system prompts.

history.change: getConfiguredNetworks returns empty for normal apps
